_comment: Sound queue for The Squatchfather (squatchfather.html). Every cue the scene plays, whether or not a file exists for it yet. Nothing here is loaded at runtime today — all of it is synthesised in src/squatchfather/audio/* — so this is the generation list, not a dependency. To replace a cue, drop a file in this folder under the given `file` name and wire it in audio/core.js. `playedBy` names the code that makes the sound today; `status` is "placeholder-synth" where something already plays and "queued" where nothing does yet. `seconds` is a target, not a limit. `loop` means it must be seamless — those run continuously and are mixed by gain.

_direction.room: Small dim restaurant under an elevated railway, late, half full.
_direction.restraint: No score, no stingers, no impact hits. The train is the only thing that builds.
_direction.mix: Everything except ear.ringing drops behind a low-pass while the bathroom door is shut, and again for ten seconds after the shots.
_direction.voice: Underplayed throughout. Prospect says as little as possible and never raises his voice; Sal is reasonable and warm right up until he isn't; McClawsky is bored.

sfx.brief: Small dim Italian restaurant, half full. Low room tone, cutlery, a couple of murmured conversations well back. No music, no laughter. Seamless loop.
Just the diners: two or three indistinct conversations, no intelligible words, low and even. Layered under ambience.room so it can be ducked on its own. Seamless loop.
Night street under an elevated railway after rain. Tyres hissing on wet asphalt, distant city, no voices. Seamless loop.
Hard tiled room tone with a faint ballast hum. The drip is a separate cue. Seamless loop.
Muffled restaurant kitchen behind a closed door: pans, a low extractor. Heard through a wall, so no highs. Seamless loop.
One fork or glass touching a plate across the room. Small, dry, unremarkable. Three variations.
A single drop into standing water in a tiled room.
One car passing on wet road, swelling by and away. Nothing sporty.
A short car horn several streets away, flattened by distance.
Elevated train bed, played at rising gain: steel structure resonating, low and broad. No wheel detail. Seamless loop.
The mid band of the same pass — the part that arrives late and makes conversation hard. Seamless loop, mixed in above train.rumble.
Sub-bass only, 30-50Hz, the part felt through the chair. Seamless loop.
Wheels crossing a rail joint overhead: two metallic knocks close together. Fired repeatedly and faster as it arrives.
Long flat two-tone horn a long way off. Mournful, not urgent.
Optional: the full pass directly overhead at maximum, if the layered beds don't sell the final exchange.
A handgun fired inside a small hard room. Painfully loud, short crack, then the room slapping back twice. The loudest thing in the scene by a wide margin.
Press check on a semi-auto: slide eased back and let forward. Two small metallic events, dry — he is doing it quietly.
A pistol dropped on hardwood from waist height. One heavy knock, a smaller settle, then nothing.
Tinnitus after two indoor gunshots: steady sine around 4kHz with a fainter partial. Seamless loop, faded out over ten seconds.
One footstep, leather sole, on old hardwood. Four to six variations.
One footstep on bathroom tile — harder, with a short slap of room. Four to six variations.
One footstep on wet pavement, slight water in it. Four to six variations.
A wooden restaurant chair pulled back over hardwood. Not a screech — he is not making a scene.
A chair settling as someone sits, or knocked as they stand. Also used when McClawsky goes over backwards.
A heavy glazed front door pulled open: hinge, and a breath of street arriving.
The same door closing and latching, shutting the street out.
A light interior door closing in a tiled room, with the room's slap on it. Marks the moment the restaurant goes far away — wants to be its own asset.
Suit fabric: a napkin placed down, a jacket shifting, cloth unwrapped from something heavy. Three variations.
Red wine poured into a glass at the table, unhurried.
A wine glass going over on a laid table, rolling, and breaking on the floor.
A hand moving over cold porcelain and dusty pipe, feeling for something. Close, dry, slightly desperate.
Knuckles finding a cistern pipe instead of what he is looking for. The sound of nothing being there.
One slow heavy heartbeat, felt more than heard. Played faster as the search goes on.
One controlled breath through the nose, getting louder and less controlled. Three variations.
A heavy 1970s car door closing on a quiet street. The last sound in the scene.
